item.title: Time to Get Active on Super Collapses
item.description: $1.2B First Guardian/Shield super collapse hits 11,000 investors as deadlines loom; AFCA and Netwealth payouts underway - check if you’re affected

item.title: Nordic Resources Extends Kopsa Gold Mineralisation Further North
item.description: Nordic Resources (ASX: NNL) extends Kopsa gold-copper mineralisation north, outside the MRE, with drill results and potential resource growth; A$12m cash.

item.title: Spacetalk Executes Strategic MOU with Vodafone Australia for Family Safety Software
item.description: Spacetalk signs 12-month MOU with Vodafone Australia via TPG to distribute Family Safety software to postpaid customers, targeting $20-25m ARR by CY2026.

item.title: European Resources Confirms Standout 31.5m Intersection at Korsnäs Project in Finland
item.description: European Resources logs 31.5m at Korsnäs with 4,902ppm TREO (NdPr-enriched); southern target validated, spotlighting Korsnäs as Europe’s REE hub.

item.title: Red Mountain Mining Continues Push to Advance US and Australian Critical Minerals Portfolio
item.description: Red Mountain Mining (ASX: RMX) pushes ahead in US-Australian critical minerals with Thompson Falls antimony acquisition, high-grade assays and expansion plans.

item.title: Bass Oil Awarded $3.5m SA Government Grant for Kiwi Gas Project
item.description: Bass Oil (ASX: BAS) awarded $3.5m SA government grant for Kiwi liquids-rich gas project; pipeline to Cooper Basin; online by end-2028.

item.title: Dreadnought Resources Adds High Range Northwest Prospect to Mangaroon Gold Project
item.description: Dreadnought Resources adds High Range Northwest to Mangaroon gold project after strong gold-in-stream anomalies; now seven camp-scale prospects.

item.title: Radiopharm Theranostics Doses First Patient in RV-01 Phase 1/2a Trial for Aggressive Cancers
item.description: RAD doses first patient in RV-01 Phase 1/2a trial for aggressive cancers, a 177Lu-radiotherapeutic targeting B7-H3, to define dose for future studies.

item.title: Anax Metals Reinforces Outstanding Economics with Whim Creek DFS
item.description: Anax Metals' Whim Creek DFS flags base-case NPV7 A$501m, IRR 98% (spot 118%/A$649m); ~A$723m cash flow over 10 years; 12–14 month payback; funding crucial.

item.title: ClearView Wealth Receives $415m Takeover Bid from Zurich Insurance Group
item.description: ClearView Wealth (CVW) faces a $415m takeover bid from Zurich; cash $0.65/share (~20% vs 3m VWAP, ~26% vs 12m VWAP) — board unanimously backs the scheme.
